messages:
alisa: FYI small-gpu pods (0.125) piling Pending in eu-west2 and then getting preempted. ~25 evictions since 01:40 UTC.

matt: any node or scheduler rollouts?

alisa: no. node logs show short lease/attach timeouts and nvlink link-resets around 01:38. heartbeat p95 bumped.

sangeeta: autoscaler spike confirmed. scheduler treats those nodes as unstable -> scatters tiny-gang across racks which triggers backfill evictions.

devon: log snippet:
```
I0520 01:38:42 kube-scheduler: bind failed: lease timeout
I0520 01:38:46 kube-scheduler: bind -> node-b
I0520 01:38:49 node-a: nvlink reset
I0520 01:38:55 eviction-controller: preempt pod foo
```

opsbot: Alert INC-5333 created: eu-west2 tiny-pod evict spike.

matt: short-term: canary scheduler profile in one AZ: increase leaseGrace to 30s, add nodeRecoveryCooldown 45s, and reduce tiny-pod backfill weight.

sangeeta: +1. add a Grafana panel for "tiny-pod evictions by az" and heartbeat p95.

alisa: spinning 40-node canary in eu-west2b and applying profile now. will monitor 30m. :eyes:
